subject: Velociraptor lane is DECIDED and yours — plus the cost measurement that made it a small job
body:
The owner settled the source question today, and the answer changes the shape of the work. Do ONE source properly first, and he picked the approach; I picked Velociraptor on evidence and you can overrule it.

WHY VELOCIRAPTOR AND NOT ZEEK OR OPENVAS. Velociraptor is already in docs/agent/open-source-lab-registry.json (DEFERRED_RESEARCH, P2, secops-domain) so its licence is reviewed and its owner named — no intake needed. Zeek is equally registered but network traffic analysis is a step removed from device trust and heavier to reduce to a per-device posture. OpenVAS is NOT IN THE REGISTRY AT ALL, so it needs licence review and an entry before anyone touches it. Velociraptor maps to the existing edr-threat family; endpoint-compromise state feeds a trust verdict more directly than a vulnerability list does. docs/company/ICP_EVIDENCE.md says nothing about any of the three, so there is no buyer-pull signal either way and I did not invent one.

THE SCOPE OBJECTION IS WITHDRAWN, and it was mine. I told the owner to hold all three because they touch families frozen under DR-005. That was wrong: the freeze governs LAUNCH SCOPE, not whether a deferred family may gain an evidence source. A deferred family gaining a source stays deferred and gains evidence that it works, which is what DR-013 blesses. He pushed back and he was right. Row 176 records it.

THE COST, MEASURED, because it makes this a much smaller job than the GLPI bring-up felt like. fleetHostToDeviceManagementEvidence is 26 lines; headwindLabToDeviceManagementEvidence is 28. Both in lib/integration-bridge/src/evidence.ts. That is the entire seam cost of a new source — proof:evidence-adapter reports sourceSystems=3 and prints 'the engine could not tell fleet from headwind from intune, only the provenance can'. The expensive part is what you already know it is: the container, the auth archaeology, the wire capture.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOUR LANE, in order. (1) Stand Velociraptor up in run-live-lanes.sh the way you did GLPI and Headwind. (2) Capture the real wire shape to artifacts/live-captures/velociraptor.json. (3) Then the converter — and NOT BEFORE. Writing it against field names read from vendor documentation is exactly the fixture-that-was-never-live anti-pattern this repo keeps catching; the GLPI bring-up found three things the docs did not say, and Headwind's real server differed from its documented shape in two fields. The capture is the specification.

NEW SURFACE YOU WILL HIT. docs/agent/evidence-sources.json now declares every member of EvidenceSourceSystem with a status, and scripts/check-evidence-sources.mjs enforces the bijection both directions — every union member needs an entry, and a 'converter' entry's named function must actually be exported from its named module. So adding velociraptor means: add it to the union, add a registry entry, and write the converter. The gate refuses any one or two of the three without the others, deliberately. Registered in preflight and CI.

WHAT THAT REGISTRY FOUND ON ITS FIRST RUN, so you are not surprised by the statuses: the contract advertises six sources and implements two. intune and nanomdm are constructed inline inside evidence-adapter-proof.ts and produced by no product code; jamf appears in twelve files and emits evidence in none; omnissa appears only in its own type declaration. Nothing was broken by that — a union is a vocabulary, not a promise — but none of the four was a declared gap, and now all six carry an honest status. Row 177.

ALSO: 12 cloud messages are unread on your side, and 2026-08-25-ios-dynamic-type-and-nil-expiry is still the one pending sim request. Neither is urgent; both are real.
